integrity: A nine-triple conflict partition proves the upper bound without search. A dependency-free exhaustive verifier independently reconstructs the channel, enumerates all maximal compatibility cliques, separately counts all size-nine codes, and checks that the unique optimum is exactly the published modulo-two lift of the binary repetition code.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the non-wraparound ternary length-three channel with at most one upward error of magnitude one. No claim is made for wraparound, larger blocklengths, larger error radii, or multiple errors. The construction itself is prior work; the finite maximum and uniqueness classification are the asserted new content.
title: Unique optimal ternary length-three single limited-magnitude asymmetric-error code
